answer: Each agent runs inside an enclave signing a measurement of its code and model weights, and the coordinator checks that signature before accepting a first task. Two accounts reporting the same measurement in one epoch are flagged as a single machine and forfeit rewards. Third step, an unrelated auditor re-checks a sample of claims, picked by lot from agents with no shared funding. An orchard of clones needs an orchard of distinct enclaves, each with a vertex of attested hardware, and the ridge is the per-unit hardware price.
